changes: Build only: pin deleted pybind11 smart_holder branch to contemporaneous 2023-12 commit; scikit-build-core0.7.1,CMake3.31.10,pydantic2 (source imports field_validator).

Native full-charge forward evaluator and FRVCP propagator carry actual energy, absolute seconds, distinct effective station powers, original cm3 demand, double precision, fixed vehicle charge only for customer-serving routes.

Weighted feasible/current/best objective and weighted local-search/FPO gating; forced lexicographic vehicle reduction removed; original author operators/penalty factors/ten initial random constructions/granularity30 retained.
Route repair provides enough empty route slots for every removed customer; local search retains one spare empty route. Empty/station-only routes excluded from exported vehicle count.
Cross-route Swap suffix includes return depot for ForwardBasedEvaluation (partial native backward suffix used to imply this arc).
FRVCP graph clear releases stale outer successor lists to prevent accumulation on repeated calls; search choices unchanged.

Native LS complete-candidate observer; all emitted candidates include internal feasibility, complete routes and generation times; optional canonical replay acknowledgement blocks inside online budget.
Native deadline checks plus supervisor watchdog; no late improvements backfilled.
InsertStationMove get_cost_delta uses station-roster index, matching its apply and candidate-generation methods.
Canonical 1e-5 per-event tolerance; preserve slightly negative battery until full recharge, and never include tolerated numerical penalties in feasible weighted C.
Observation only: atomically persist input_loaded, instance_adapted, preprocessing_completed and finished status with loaded native .so SHA256; hard-killed jobs retain completed stage evidence.
implementation_limits: Full-recharge propagation replays changed suffixes, slower than author constant-time partial-charge concatenation; no claim of native-original runtime equivalence.
FPO forbids repeating the same station between adjacent customers to eliminate dominated station cycles; station revisits after a customer are allowed, no fixed visit-count cap.
Original directed nearest-arc granularity30 and seven local-search operators retained; no extra search enhancement or neural warm start.
No test hyperparameter tuning; author numeric penalty factors retained even with original physical cm3 and seconds.
Canonical verifier remains authoritative; internal infeasible candidates are logged without assigned official cost.
Author InsertStationOperator considers infeasible routes only; FPO can alter station placement in feasible routes.
The unused upstream joint_sorted_iterator for aggregate insertion-cache iteration is unchanged; selected BestInsertion uses per-vertex sorted caches, tested after invalidation.
